LanguageData.AA_CodexTipsBody: - Every level grants 1 perk point (2 on every fifth level) and 1 attribute point. - Nodes need a connected, learned node above them. Deeper rows also need levels and your primary attribute. - Keystones in the same row are mutually exclusive: pick one. - Right-click any spell button to toggle autocast or hide it. Autocast only fires while drafted (healing also works undrafted). - Ward is an arcane barrier that absorbs damage before health and regenerates after 5 seconds out of combat. - A tome of unmaking (Higher Arcana research) refunds all your points. - Mana draughts restore mana instantly. Brew them at the arcane lectern.
